saw_lines: People rarely switch laundry detergent once a box is working, so the first pick sticks until something goes wrong.
So the sale is won in the first line, where a buyer decides if strips fit their wash.
Your site says 200'000 customers wash with bluu, yet 0 of 29 ads carry that number. Put 200'000 on the creative and in line one of three ads.

ads.source: Meta Ad Library, active ads, 20 Oct 2026
points: Your site says 200'000 customers wash with bluu, yet 0 of 29 ads carry that number, so cold buyers get no proof. Put 200'000 on the creative and in line one of three ads, and open two with a customer quote.
Your site offers at least 20% off, yet 0 of 18 ads mention percent off or any offer. A first buyer has no reason to act today. Put the 20% off in line one of three ads and on the creative.
One exact copy runs in 7 of 18 ads, so the same people see the same pitch again and tune out. Keep the body text, but give each of those 7 ads a new opening line and a new product shot.

12 ads have run 60+ days, so you have proven winners. Yet one winner shows the same audience one message. Build three variations of the oldest winner, each with a new hook, a different product shot and the offer up front.
